text:
Maria: Heads-up: PR #4481 touches console presets + the telemetry ledger and adds a tiny kv-prefetch example. Need an owner for docs review, smoke tests, and a short migration note for the trace hook param rename. cc @DevEx Jake @SRE Sam
DevEx Jake: On it — can you paste the staging preview link?
Maria: preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4481 :eyes: Changes: presets schema tweak, telemetry ledger update, and a single-line example for kv-prefetch. Key rename: `traceKey` -> `trace_id`. SDK snippets will need updates.
Lee (eng-ml): Quick question — is the `traceKey` rename runtime-safe for Dedicated/private deployments?
SRE Sam: It should be fine. We added a compatibility shim in runtime v2.1.0 that accepts `traceKey` and maps to `trace_id`. Please include a note so customers know older agents won't break.
Kate (product): Can we add a short cost/latency before/after example for kv-prefetch? A couple of customers asked how it affects unit cost and tail latency.
Maria: Added a short table in the doc draft. Jake — can you run the docs smoke and linkcheck? Command: ```./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 4481 --suite quick --linkcheck```
DevEx Jake: 👍 Running now. I'll also update Node + Python SDK snippets in this PR. Will push a patch commit to keep changes together.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 4481 -> staging (ETA ~3m)
DevEx Jake: Smoke results: all checks passed except linkcheck: 1 failure (old tracehook guide link). Leaving a comment on the PR.
Maria: I'll patch the link and add a redirect note to the tracehook migration section.
Lee (eng-ml): We should include a minimal migration snippet showing how to map `ctx.traceKey` -> `ctx.trace_id` across SDKs. Small example helps prevent regressions.
Maria: Added snippets in the PR comment: 
```js
// JS migration
// old
span.setTag('traceKey', ctx.traceKey)
// new
span.setTag('trace_id', ctx.trace_id)
```
```py
# Python migration
# old
span.tags['traceKey'] = ctx['traceKey']
# new
span.tags['trace_id'] = ctx['trace_id']
```
DevEx Jake: Pushed SDK snippet update as commit 8f3a2d. Left PR comment to reviewers to check formatting and backcompat note.
SRE Sam: I'll add a short note under Performance > KV prefetch about latency SLO impact (small table + microbenchmark numbers). Suggest calling out worst-case tail latency for 99th.
Kate (product): For cost, add an example: "kv-prefetch reduced token churn but added ~0.8 tokens/request on average for prefetch writeback" — that's what the microbench showed.
Maria: Added reviewers: @Lee (eng-ml), @DevEx Jake, @SRE Sam. Aim to merge by EOD. Any objections?
Kate (product): No objections, looks good :shipit: 
DevEx Jake: LGTM from me once linkfix and snippets are in.
Maria: Link fixed and redirect note added. Docs-staging preview refreshed: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4481/preview
deploy-bot: deploy finished: docs-staging 4481 -> staging (status: success)
Maria: Merged to main and backported to v2.1.x. Closing this thread — thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
Kate (product): Nice one — good ship! :tada:
